title.zh: 将黎刹省马里基纳市镇巴扬巴扬村更名为康塞普西翁村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Bayan-Bayanan, Municipality of Marikina, Province of Rizal, to Concepcion
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Bayan-Bayanan, Municipality of Marikina, Province of Rizal, to Concepcion
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Bayan-Bayanan, Thị trấn Marikina, Tỉnh Rizal thành Concepcion
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Bayan-Bayanan, เทศบาล Marikina, จังหวัด Rizal เป็น Concepcion
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Bayan-Bayanan, Kotamadya Marikina, Provinsi Rizal menjadi Concepcion
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Bayan-Bayanan, Perbandaran Marikina, Wilayah Rizal menjadi Concepcion

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1514_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Bayan-Bayanan, Municipality of Marikina, Province of Rizal, is changed to Concepcion.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
